crossRefs.note: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him who I didn’t know.
I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul…
I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

translations.web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
